units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:25">Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 25</cite> (Y. <cite ref="Q02191"><he>פּוֹ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q00441"><he>פּוּ׳</he></cite>). Targ. Y. I ib. XV, 25 <cite ref="Q00132"><he>פַּדְעָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:11:1">Koh. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>או חד פדעה</he> or he receives a blow (from a noxious animal, v. <cite ref="A02032"><he>אמכותי</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="Q01506"><he>פִּדְעִין</he></cite> or <he>פְּדָעִין</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:12">Esth. R. to I, 22</cite> (Par. 5) <he>פ׳ דמגן</he> (transl. of <he>פצעים חנם</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 23:29">Prov. XXIII, 29</cite>) wounds unrequited. V. <cite ref="Q00165"><he>פּוּדְעֲתָא</he></cite>.
